avis.texte: Ordered this for the first time. Opened it and this is how it came. No pump or anything to get it out. It also was clumpy. I contacted Ulta online and they told me to return it to a store for a new one. So I drove to my nearest Ulta an hour away, they were out of it. So I returned it and never got to use it.
I wish I started this sooner…great product for mature skin and i think even younger ones may use thia to prevent premature aging specially if they live in a ace like Texas
Been using for a couple of weeks lines around mouth are smoothing out not that they were really deep but can see improvement
I started using this about 5 weeks ago and my skin looks amazing. It really helps with breakouts too.
The top area on my tube leaks product; not sure what I think about the product yet (first time buyer) but the tube top design needs some improvement

Wow is all I can say. I didn't have super high expectations because I was just on a skincare journey and in it for the long haul. I have always been into skincare but ithis is my first time being consistent retinoids. I knew retinaldehydes were the best option so I started with this product. From the start, my skin was never dry (normal skin, warm climate, 50 years old for reference), it handled it well. I went through 3 tubes and then without really even studying my skin, I started noticing how clear my skin was looking, the dark spots had faded so then I really studied it and was really blown away! There was a point in time where they were getting darker, but that's because they were coming to the surface in order to slough off. I'm super happy with my results and have just placed an order for the .15.and I'll see how that goes! I don't have a lot of wrinkles yet (thank you genetics) so I can really only speak to the dark spots. The good thing about this company is that they will never let you turn into the wicked stepmom because their shipping is super fast. I even ordered on a Saturday over a holiday weekend. It arrived on Tuesday, even though it had to go through Sunday and the holiday on Monday. Unbelievable!! Thank you so much. I will be long time a customer! Great products for a fair price and fantastic customer service!!
I bought this as a holiday present to myself and the pump doesn't work. This is my first time trying Naturium and I'm pretty disappointed; can't recommend this to anyone.

avis.titre: Don't buy: The staining is real.
avis.texte: And the stains don't come out. The formula is yellow. Retinaldehyde is midler than retinol, but it's inevitably yellow.
Gentle, effective--perfect for a powerful agining evening routine.

Started with .05% and then went to .10% without much result. Also very staining. I had yellow under my nails most times I couldn't get off. Save up a few more pennies and get very low prescription tret (0.025%) like I did.

I am in love! I did not expect a change in texture so quickly! I use adapalene in the day, olay retinol max at night but needed to upgrade the as mount of retinol as its been years on the same routine. This stuff is amazing. I noticed a change in days! Smoothed out texture. I can't wait to see what it does in 2 months. Wow. Love it!

I do enjoy this product and have had no issues. This feels great and I will continue to purchase. The only negative is the packaging. The opening is too large, you have to be careful otherwise WAY too much product comes out. The opening needs to be smaller or have a pump.

I see these comments with great results. I'm sorry I can't say the same. I stared with the .05% and I was doing well but after 6 months went up to the 0.10% I continue to use for another 8 months and my skin started to look more dull rather then better, the wrinkles were more pronounced. I regret switching from another affordable brand that I stop using for this one. I felt as if I went back on my skin care journey rather than forward.

avis.titre: .10% is not for those with dry/sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I bought this serum after slowly increasing my retinal %, starting with .01 (from another brand) then switched to Naturium .05%, and my skin did well with both. I use the "sandwich" method because I have dry skin in the winter, and I double moisturize on top. Hoping to see more substantial results, I started using the .10%. I kept following the same methods, and using every other day/every 3 days as I was with the lower %. Now my skin is SO flaky and scaly around my nose, chin, upper lip, and forehead. I stopped using it a week ago and have been using moisturizing serums and creams and I am still so flaky/scaly/red. I would not recommend increasing to the .10% if you have dry and sensitive skin. Unfortunately now I have a whole tube of this serum that I am afraid to use.

If you are in need of a retinol product, I highly recommend this one. Using retinaldehyde, this is a great step up in your retinol journey to get great results without a prescription. Never too harsh and does not interact with other products. Get it!!
I had bumps in my skin and after few days using this product, the bumps in my cheeks are gone.

I've only just started using this, but it appears my face looks better. Time will tell. I like that this company uses natural ingredients. At first I was skeptical of science based Ingredients, but their website explains the why and what they do to compliment one another. I'm happy and much more affordable then GOOP.
I had zero issues using this on my extremely sensitive acne prone skin. Plumps your skin and minimizes fine lines. I am repurchasing for sure.
This is a gentle retinoid, but also very effective on my 2nd tube. Competitive price for encapsulated retinal. Will love a higher percentage of 0.2% though!
I was a bit hesitant to try a retinol as I am prone to sensitive and dry skin, but I've had no reactions and I see a difference in texture already

avis.titre: I won't be purchasing this product again.
avis.texte: I'm in my early 70s, with very few wrinkles and fine lines, and have been using this product for over a year. I haven't seen any improvement in my skin, however, it may work for others. I won't be purchasing another tube.
This has done so much to my skin in terms of smoothing and brightening. I am so impressed what it did on my first bottle. A must try!

I use this with the Azelaic Acid as well as the Copper Peptides....they work wonders together! All of these products are so well formulated, they feel luxurious, and are so affordable! Could not recommend more! I would love to get on a prescribed retinol, however I believe this is a fantastic alternative (for now). I would work your way up to this one. I found it better to use the retinol cream first, and then the lower dosage of this exact serum (0.05%)

avis.titre: Have tried lots of retinol and this is the BEST
avis.texte: I have been using this product for a little over a month and I am very impressed with it ! Skin tone is improved , look of pores is improved , improvement in fine lines and wrinkles ! The packaging and pump is top notch it gets all of the product out without much waste .
Product is gentle and absorbs nicely, doesn't sit on top of the skin and no redness despite daily use. The only bummer is that when my package arrived, the tube dispenser was broken.

If this was my first Naturium productI wouldn't like the brand, however, I have used many Naturium products which I've liked so I know this one is the outlier. This serum made me break out constantly even after giving it months for my skin to get used to. It also stained all of my pillowcases an orange tint.
Its removing my deep set lines, large pores, texture, ance scars & overall appearance of the skin. I use it every night, does Not cause peeling, redness or any breakout. 10/10

avis.titre: The only product that has made a difference.
avis.texte: I have normal to dry sensitive skin. I get the occasional breakout that always leaves super dark scars that never seem to fade no matter what I would use. Over time these marks add up, and I tried every chemical exfoliant under the sun and nothing would lighten them up. I've always been afraid of trying any type of retinol because I have sensitive skin and not to mention the dreaded purge that everyone talks about.i saw that this serum is supposed to be more gentle yet effective so i decided to give it a shot. I started off with the stronger one using it just one night a week working my way up to almost every night now. It's been a little over a month and my skin is the softest and smoothest it's ever been, and my acne marks are all almost gone! Luckily I never had a purging phase. My skin does get slightly dry when I use it, but my moisturizer takes care of that. I'm so happy that I decided to try this. I can't wait to see how my skin continues to improve.
I haven't been using the product long but the subtle changes I am seeing I am liking.
This cream serum improved my skin's texture in a short period of time. Highly recommend. You can't go wrong with Naturium.

avis.titre: A great alternative to prescription Retinol
avis.texte: I don't want to go the prescription route so this is the best way to get a Retinol product into my evening skincare routine. Haven't had any skin issues using this on the regular. Once in a while my skin will seem dryer than usual so I will skip a night but for the most part it's something I enjoy using. Creamy texture but sinks in quickly and easily.

This is such a great product! It's highly effective and so gentle. I never get any redness or breakouts, nor do I feel the dry eye / sensitivity around the eye that I get from using retinol. This stuff is fantastic!

avis.titre: The Only Retinoid My Skin Can Tolerate
avis.texte: This is the only retinoid that I have been able to use with any success. I highly recommend this to anyone who has not been able to use other retinoids. I have been using this for just a few months, and it has made such a difference! I use an essence, Naturium Retinaldehyde .10, the Barrier Bounce, and then the Skin Soothing Recovery Lotion in my nighttime routine. My skin looks so hydrated and glowy in the morning!
I use this on my neck and décolleté area and noticed that my neck looks a little tighter and the chest area smoother.
This product is excellent! Best retinaldehyde I've tried, and I've tried several. Non-irritating, non-staining. I REALLY love it!

Love this. I used the lower percentage a few months ago and was able to tolerate so I bumped up to this percentage. I have sensitive skin so I was hesitant. I've only been using it a few weeks but I can tell it's working. I'm starting slowly by using it only twice a week. Maybe in another week I'll bump it up to 3 days a week. For me It can be drying but I just double up my moisturizer. And my face is always glowing after I use it.
This is nice, I really appreciate how it plays nice with my other skincare.

avis.titre: will never  NOT be in my routine
avis.texte: 55 years young, this is on my skin every night before my moisturizer . my skin is smoother, brighter and I love this product. All of their products are fantastic

I can't say enough about this retinaldehyde!!! I am a Tretinoin girl. But when I use this I wake up with radiant, plumpy, youthful skin. Something in this formulation is exceptional!! Love this!! Will never be without it!
Honestly this retinaldehyde is soooo good and has a price tag you just cannot beat

I've been a retinal user for many years and decided to try Naturium to compare with my long-time favorite. Well, this retinal serum is now my go-to! I feel like it does the sane great job as my old one, but this serum is a bit thicker and easier to spread, and it works into my skin easily without leaving it shiny or sticky.

I was on Tretinoin for 5 months w/ constant irritation before I switched to this retinaldehyde. 3 months in and my skin is better than ever. I pair it with the Azelaic Acid Emulsion. Thank you Naturium!

I cannot recommend this product enough to all of my friends. I do a gentle cleanse, exfoliate, Retinaldehyde, and follow up with Naturium's overnight moisturizer... Hands down the best night time regimen I've ever had!
I love this formula. It's great on my sensitive skin and very light.
Cream goes on very smooth . Will buy again . Highly recommend

I really like this product. I've used several Retinols. This seems to be much more moisturizing along with all the other regular functions. I can use without redness or irritation. Price is great and a tube lasts a bit over a month with every other day use.
Love it so much. It is my favorite and easy on my sensitive skin.
Very effective and no sensitivity or dryness. I use it every other night along with moisturizer.
So far, so good. I have not used it long enough to start seeing a lot of results. I do like how it makes my skin fee; very soft and not dry and flaky. Time will tell for the other benefits.
Great product! Doesn't make my skin irritated, fragrance free, great consistency and packaging! My skin looks more glowy and even.

avis.titre: Has worked quite well for me
avis.texte: It's my favorite retinal serum. It's lightweight, and it was working quite well for my acne. It definitely has the best texture out of every retinal I've tried too. Recently my skin has been breaking out more though, and while I still love this serum, I have thought about switching over to adapalene to see if it would help more.
Love the texture and I am already seeing improvements in my hyperpigmentation I'm such a short amount of time!
This product feels good on the skin. I really only use it twice a week so I'm not sure how long before I'm expected to see results.

I've been using it for about a month and so far it's great and have received compliments on my skin. I haven't experienced any extra dryness but I started using it every other day just in case. I typically use the Naturium marula oil or the ceramide rice moisture cream after applying only because I have dry skin.
It's keeping my skin bright and glowing without the constant peeling that I had with tretinoin. I'm using it every night on my face, neck and chest.

LOVE the Retinaldehyde 0.10%. I just finished the 0.05% and my skin did great with it so I bumped it up to the 0.10% and have had zero sensitivity or reaction. My skin just loves it! I can definitely tell it's stronger and my skin is responding really well so far. Can't wait for the longer-term results. My skin seems to tolerate retinaldehyde a little better than retinol (in case you get sensitivity to retinol, that doesn't mean you will also have it with this).
I am so glad I found this affordable Retinaldehyde product. Could not be happier with the result. The same potent product but best value ever.

avis.titre: Do not second guess, BUY it!
avis.texte: I absolutely LOVE this retinal! I was using PC before but can def tell the diff with this product (potency). I've finally finished purging and WOW. My skin is plump and blemishes are fading. Thank you so much!
I like this cream serum so far. My skin is very soft and smooth. Just hoping it will even out my skin tone. I have some melasma and reddish spots that are persistent. It's only been a week though.
this is my second purchase of this like this see how this works after few months and review again.
Goes on smooth, no grease and I have gotten to many compliments on how flawless and glowy my skin looks!
So far I'm really enjoying this product! It's not irritating to my skin and my skkns overall appearance is improved!

avis.titre: Don't pass up on this one!
avis.texte: Holy grail for smooth glowing skin! Game changer for those who have dull skin and need a boost in their routine!
Just switched over to this stronger version and so far my skin is loving this, no irritation or bad reaction

I've used retinol in one form or another for a few years, but nothing really made a noticeable difference until I started using this! Within the first week my skin just started looking better. It has a bit of a glow, definitely softer and any blemishes clear up really quickly. Really wish I'd started this sooner!

avis.titre: Great product at a great price
avis.texte: This formula is light and gentile on the skin. I only need to moisturize after, not before like other products. Along with exfoliating, I've noticed fine lines going away and firmer skin in four weeks of daily use. This is a staple in my routine!
I just started using this and it is no joke. I realized I can't wear it every night (yet), but already feel and see a difference with my texture and pore size.
I started with the .05% and didn't see much of a difference but I've been loving the .1%! Gentle enough to use every night

So far so good. Have only had the opportunity to use this a few times now after using the .05% version for the past several months. I'm working it in slowly, once or twice a week while I finish off my tube of the lower percentage and have not experienced any irritation or issues so far. Great retinal products. Actually one that I look forward to consistently using after several years of sporadically trying other brands/formulations in fits and starts that I wasn't happy with.
My neck is very sensitive and this is the only product it can tolerate. Plus this is even stronger than retinol! Won't be without it and you can't beat the price👍

I haven't been using this long enough to see results but I do like this product so far. It hasn't given me any irritation like some of the other retinol products I've tried. It has a great thin consistency and I love the packaging. Very excited to see future results.
This serum is a game changer. Its potent formula worked wonders on my skin, leaving it noticeably smoother and brighter. A must-have for anyone seeking effective skincare results.

Switched from Tretinoin to this and my skin is reaping all the benefits and none of the irritation. I would say this is more of a gel cream texture than a traditional cream, very hydrating product but spreads very easily with minimal product used. Wish they would keep upgrading the strength of their retinal serums.
Really enjoying the higher percentage, my skin has been looking amazing after using this every other evening.
Wow, just Wow! Never had a product work right out the box. Will be part of my everyday.
I love the texture and ease of using this serum. I've not experienced any irritation.
I like it a lot but too soon to tell the results. Definitely going slow until my skin acclimates to the high concentration. Feels good on my skin.

I purchased this for traveling and wanted something in an airless pump, and this fit the bill. Both my sister and I enjoyed this product, nice texture, and no irritation to either of our skin. We have combo skin and has a good amount of product. Can't report on results yet, since it's only been 2 and a half weeks, but really enjoying it.
Love the formulation of ingredients. Would love to see an even stronger strength.

Need more time to see results . So can't give 5 stars . The serum feels creamy and smooth and absorbs quickly. Didn't have any of the dryness that can accompany retinol use.Would layer moisturizer on top.
I have used a lot of retinol products, but never had results like this. It took a good three weeks of once daily (at night) use, but my lip lines are definitely lightened.
I have slightly sensitive skin, but have been using another retinol for some time before trying this to try and amp-up my routine. Definitely glad I switched! My skin feels and looks amazing!

This stuff works! Defiantly need to build up your retinol tolerance. I found that I had a little pealing in some areas the next day. Overall, absorbs quickly, no pilling, no smell. Great product! There is so much fluff out there, this is the real deal for an amazing price!
Awesome product. The retinaldehyde cream does everything it's supposed to, and more!

I was on my third tube of the .05 Retinaldehyde serum and used it every night for many months. I definitely saw improvements in the finest lines and in overall texture as well. When the .10 was announced, I ordered it that day. I can tell the difference in product strength! I am actually instinctively in a skin cycling program now. I had a tiny bit of dryness and the slightest peeling around my brows and nasal creases. So, I know the .10 is a more powerful product. I am really happy about it and look forward to even more improvements in the coming months. As info, I am using the .10 3-4 nights per week. Also, I have very oily, tolerant skin. So, I suspect that if your skin is dry or sensitive, you may wish to incorporate this new serum at a slow and measured pace. But I do believe it will be helpful and can be done. (Female, fair skin, 40yrs old).

Recently started using. Did not irritate my skin but I've been using lower strength for past 6months. Hoping to see good results. None of the naturium products ever disappointed me. Keep up the good work.
Very strong even for my skin that has gotten a co2 laser. Finally something that I feel works right away.

avis.texte: Pathetic and awful service ,once u bought something if u didn't get ur product they will never reach you. they will not give u replacement at all. U will end up loosing ur money and time . They will neither give u replacement nor refund. Natrium will play with u in email. ORDER #514763 Use tracking Number: IEN245509516N1
Wish it had a low level light scent or no scent. It smells like most SPF-chemical and off putting. Don't care for that

While the benefits of retinaldehyde are more of a long game, I'm happy that this Naturium serum is not irritating and at an excellent price point. I've used retinol in the past, and that didn't give any tangible benefits; tretinoin was much too strong and gave me a flaky face. The retinal seems to hit a sweet spot, with my complexion looking brighter and no dryness. I mostly use this for long term benefits, as my sunscreen is my most important skincare product, but I like this enough to repurchase.
Literally in one use I saw a difference, skin feels so soft and smooth, excited to see what it does to dark spots

avis.titre: Highly recommend!! Just use a dark pillowcase!
avis.texte: It took a short period of time for my skin to get used to it but I can truly say this has made a difference on my face!! My skin feels tighter and combined with the plant ceramide rich moisture cream, my skin feels extremely smooth. This is my first time using retinal (as opposed to the Naturium retinol cream that I've been using for years) and I'm impressed. My ONLY gripe is that it stains my white pillowcase with a light yellow green from the serum and it doesn't seem to come off after washing. :(( would give it 5 stars but had to knock off one for the staining. Love it otherwise and highly recommend!!

avis.titre: It works but it stains my pillows!
avis.texte: I'm a big fan of the .5 retinal serum, so I really wanted to love the .1 serum. Let me preface this by saying that I think the .1 serum is effective. It doesn't dry out my skin and it does make my skin glowy. However, I was super disappointed to wake up and see yellow stains on my pillow. I'm a side sleeper so my face does end up on the pillow and I can see exactly where my cheek was laying on the pillow. Am I supposed to sleep on my back when I use it? I only use 1-1.5 pumps, so I don't think I'm using too much. And I'm pairing it with the plant ceramide moisturizer. I didn't have a problem with staining when I was using the .5. So if I want to stick with .1, I'll have to switch to a different brand unfortunately.
Love it. No issues....love all of the Naturium products that I have bought.
I do not experience any negative reactions and can use every night

I've been using the .05% retinaldehyde cream daily since December with great results and zero irritation, I even use it around my eyes my problem (but I don't have super sensitive eyes). I upgraded to this .10% cream as soon as I saw it came out and it's just the exact same as the .05% but better results. I've been applying every night for a week, no irritation so far. Still able to use around my eyes. I had a few breakouts because I ate too much sugar, and they're healing up super fast! My overall skin tone has improved already. 10/10 PS-since the concentration is higher in this one, the color is also about twice as yellow. It does stain my eye mask if I apply too close to bedtime so just be aware of that. Personally I don't care, but others might.
